name: Tesseract Native Plan
description: Execute an exact native Tesseract request without conventional planning or inferred profiles.

inputParameters.name: planner
inputParameters.description: Exact COMPAS FAB TesseractPlanner from Tesseract Planner. Only plan_native is used.

inputParameters.name: program
inputParameters.description: Exact native CompositeInstruction, normally from Tesseract Motion Program. In-place changes invalidate cached output by binary digest.

inputParameters.name: pipeline
inputParameters.description: Exact non-empty native Task Composer pipeline name, for example DescartesFPipeline.

inputParameters.name: profiles
inputParameters.description: Required exact native ProfileDictionary. It is never inferred from pipeline. Same-object external mutation requires compute=True because 0.35.0.6 exposes no dictionary serialization.

inputParameters.name: auto_seed
inputParameters.description: Exact native auto-seed flag passed to TesseractPlanningRequest.

inputParameters.name: compute
inputParameters.description: Trigger native planning. False returns only a successful result whose planner, native scene revision, program, pipeline, profiles, and seed signature still matches.

outputParameters.name: result
outputParameters.description: Complete TesseractPlanningResult retaining exact request, native PlanningResult, and raw CompositeInstruction.
